item.summary: Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi today inaugurated the Reserve Bank of India’s newly established Data Centre and Cybersecurity Training Institute in Bhubaneswar, Odisha. Invoking the blessings of Mahaprabhu Jagannath, the Prime Minister celebrated Bhubaneswar gifting a vital new institution to New India.
